intro: Hungary is a parliamentary republic and a member of the EU and NATO, though its government has often clashed with the EU.

chapters.title: Parliament and government
text: The National Assembly, a single chamber of 199 members, chooses the prime minister. The president, elected by parliament, is head of state. A new constitution, the Fundamental Law, came into force in 2012.
From 2010 Viktor Orbán's governments described Hungary as an 'illiberal democracy'; the EU froze some funds over concerns about the courts, media and corruption.

chapters.title: Symbols
text: The flag is red, white and green. National holidays mark the 1848 revolution (15 March), St Stephen's Day (20 August) and the 1956 revolution (23 October).

keyTerms.meaning: A system with elections but weak checks on power and limited freedoms.
